meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Iron Perimeter
quests.narrative_guidance: Ensure the capital's defenses are reinforced against a potential breach.
improvisation_points: Consult Captain Orin for the fortification blueprints.
Deliver the drill requirements to Master Vex in the Pit of Trials.
Secure the necessary iron beams from Quartermaster Hrolf.

quests.title: Thermal Regulation
quests.narrative_guidance: A surge in the furnace threatens to melt the industrial district.
improvisation_points: Receive the pressure report from Overseer Blaz.
Bypass the jammed relief valve with Warden Pip in the tunnels.
Deliver the stabilized core readings to Master Gorr.

quests.title: Veins of Power
quests.narrative_guidance: A rare crystal formation has been found, requiring specialized extraction.
improvisation_points: Obtain the location data from Lyra in the Luminous Vein.
Escort the mining team led by Miner Krug.
Hand off the samples to Sentinel Brock for secure transport.

quests.title: Supply Chain Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Identify a leak in the Hegemony's logistical network.
improvisation_points: Audit the export logs with Logistician Mira.
Track the missing crates to the Molten Flow with Geologist Rhen.
Confront the black market contact near Foreman Sledge's disposal site.

quests.title: The Shadow Over Kratos-Vahl
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrators are moving through the outskirts of the capital.
improvisation_points: Report to Scout-Commander Elara for target descriptions.
Calibrate the defense cannons with Chief Bran.
Bring the captured prisoners to Medicus Thane for questioning.

quests.title: Market Stability Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: Ensure the subterranean economy remains under Hegemony control.
improvisation_points: Collect taxes from Zale in the Bedrock Bazaar.
Validate the historical ownership in the Vaults with Archivist Lorn.
Enforce the new quotas with Foreman Grog at the Gorge.

quests.title: Hegemony Integration
quests.narrative_guidance: Connect the various branches of the Hegemony's power.
improvisation_points: Receive administrative orders from Seneschal Draka.
Update the automatons' programming with Engineer Trix.
Coordinate the aquatic resource recovery with Thorne.

quests.title: The Chrono-Sync Dash
quests.narrative_guidance: A critical timing error has occurred in the transit system. You must deliver a sync-crystal through the high-speed zones.
improvisation_points: Collect the sync-crystal from Runner Elara in The Dash.
Take the crystal to Chronos Miri in Tick-Tock Tower for calibration.
Deliver the calibrated crystal to Balancer Fenn in Wire-Walk to reset the system.

quests.title: The Precision Delivery
quests.narrative_guidance: A micro-component essential for the Hegemony's stealth tech needs to be moved without a single scratch.
improvisation_points: Obtain the micro-chip from Needle Lyra in Precision-Row.
Pass through the Micro-Alley and have Scalpel Rex check for damage.
Hand over the chip to Cogswright Bix at The Gear-Teeth for installation.

quests.title: The Tangled Wire
quests.narrative_guidance: Saboteurs have loosened the main support lines in the Silken-Web. Re-tension the network before it collapses.
improvisation_points: Receive the tensioning wrench from Tension Rian on The Tightrope.
Use the wrench to secure the Suspension-Spoke with help from Tether Vane.
Deliver the report to Piercer Dax at Needle-Point.

quests.title: The Blurred Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: A rival faction has stolen a prototype engine. Reacquire it by moving faster than their sensors can track.
improvisation_points: Get the tracking coordinates from Shadow Val at The Blurred-Edge.
Intercept the courier near Zip-Lane Alpha and hand the engine to Pilot Nyx.
Meet Drift Silas at Snap-Turn Plaza to lose any pursuers.

quests.title: Spring-Loaded Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: The energy vaults are overcharging. Bleed the excess energy before the gears melt.
improvisation_points: Get the pressure valves from Coil Jora in Spring-Vault.
Adjust the settings at The Calibrator with Dial Oren.
Safely release the pressure at the Lever-Lounge under Pivot Zale's supervision.

quests.title: Silken Sway Recovery
quests.narrative_guidance: Valuable seeds for the gardens have fallen into the lower pits. Retrieve them using acrobatic skill.
improvisation_points: Get the retrieval harness from Sway Lyss in Balance-Beam Gardens.
Swing down and collect the seeds with Grapple Hoke in the Silk-Sling District.
Return the seeds to Pendulum Quin in the Sway-Yard.

quests.title: The Instant-Square Circuit
quests.narrative_guidance: Test the new rapid-response relay by completing a circuit across the spires.
improvisation_points: Start the timer with Blink Thorne at Instant-Square.
Pass through the Flicker-Step gates monitored by Mirage Kael.
Finish the lap at Glimmer-Path by checking in with Flicker Jax.

quests.title: The Signal Decay
quests.narrative_guidance: Fading signals from the spires suggest a cosmic anomaly interfering with collective transmissions.
improvisation_points: Obtain the frequency logs from Unit V-Delta in the Signal Spires.
Take the logs to Unit A-Five at the Void Observation Deck for celestial triangulation.
Deliver the findings to Unit M-Prime in the Echo Vaults to see if this anomaly has occurred in the past.

quests.title: Memory Leakage
quests.narrative_guidance: A corruption in the Memory Fields is spilling raw data into the silos, threatening system stability.
improvisation_points: Collect the corrupted memory shards from Unit M-Quat.
Transport the shards to Unit V-Gamma for temporary containment in the Data Silos.
Consult Unit A-Three in Paradox Labs to find a way to stabilize the leaking logic.

quests.title: The Integration Glitch
quests.narrative_guidance: Biological components in the Integration Pit are rejecting their synthetic grafts.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the biological rejection report from Unit V-Epsilon.
Acquire a new bonding agent from Unit A-Seven in the Synthesis Sprawl.
Verify the historical success rates of this agent with Unit M-Sept in Heritage Links.

quests.title: Protocol Override
quests.narrative_guidance: Unauthorized access attempts have been detected at the Logic Gates, requiring a security update.
improvisation_points: Receive the security breach data from Unit V-Zeta.
Test a new firewall algorithm with Unit A-Two in the Experiment Quads.
Archive the new security protocol with Unit M-Quin in the Preservation Core.

quests.title: The Paradox Extraction
quests.narrative_guidance: A theoretical discovery in the Paradox Labs requires central processing power to resolve.
improvisation_points: Gather the paradox equations from Unit A-Three.
Use the processing power of the Central Nexus via Unit V-Alpha to calculate solutions.
Log the chronological implications with Unit M-Sec at the History Chimes.

quests.title: Waste Management Efficiency
quests.narrative_guidance: Unprocessed particles in the wastes are causing traffic delays in the corridors.
improvisation_points: Get a sample of the dense particle waste from Unit A-Six.
Consult Unit V-Beta on the most efficient transit route to clear the corridors.
Drop the processed materials at the Retrieval Docks with Unit M-Ter for repurposing.

quests.title: Neural Linkage Project
quests.narrative_guidance: The Collective seeks to index the thoughts of visiting diplomats to improve integration.
improvisation_points: Obtain blank data slates from Unit M-Hex in the Silent Grottoes.
Deploy the slates in the Hypothesis Range with Unit A-One to gather initial theories.
Analyze the diplomatic data with Unit V-Eta in Neutrality Plaza.
